paper.title: Algorithm 677 (TOMS, Montefusco & Casciola 1989, MASUB scattered-data interpolation, self-check)

field: numerics (scattered-data interpolation of a rapidly varying surface, single precision)
stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 677, MASUB package and its self-check PROGRAM MAIN)

claim.text: Self-check PROGRAM MAIN of TOMS 677 (first test program): the maximum and mean absolute errors ERMAX and ERMEAN that MMERR computes for the 10x10 reconstruction (IEX=1, TP=10) against the analytic Gaussian surface, compared with the built-in ANS2 = 0.6059994 and ANS1 = 0.06695094. Registered tolerance: relative 1e-5 on each value. The paper's own values were not read; the claim is the archive's built-in reference.

cause: G2 open: the compiled units are a line-range extraction of the authors' file (a source patch, not build-only); the paper check is scout's
attempt: Measured, verdict withheld at G2. Two passes: pass 1 (gfortran -O2, recorded build) gives ERMAX 0.6059995 and ERMEAN 0.06695094; pass 2 (clean directory, -O0 rebuild) gives ERMAX 0.6059992 and ERMEAN 0.06695094. Against the built-in ANS2 0.6059994 and ANS1 0.06695094 the differences are within the registered rel 1e-5 on both values. The archive sha256 now matches the queue registration (d4d94e7a...), so the archive gate is met. Not reproduced-verdict yet: the authors' file as shipped does not compile (four PROGRAM MAINs; original attempt failed). The compiled units are two verbatim line ranges cut from it (677main.f lines 1-162, masub.f lines 634-end), and the build-only manifest record correctly exits 2 (kind source; 677.f removed, two units added). Under the method that is a source patch, so G2 needs scout's paper check of the extraction and the MASUB package against the paper. Until then the verdict is blocked.

original_attempt.reason: the archive as shipped does not compile with gfortran -O2: 'Error: Two main PROGRAMs at (1) and (2)' (four test programs in one file)
